findings.title: Login cache invalidation can compare the original IDP model with itself
findings.body: registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate detects changes by comparing the model returned from getById(model.getInternalId()) with the caller-supplied model. When the ORGANIZATION feature is disabled, createOrganizationAwareIdentityProviderModel returns the cached IdentityProviderModel directly. If a caller uses the normal getById -> mutate -> update pattern, the cached model is mutated in place, so getById inside update returns the same object as model. In that case both comparisons see identical predicate state and identical organizationId, and login caches are not invalidated even when enabled/hideOnLogin/linkOnly/organization link changed. The stale getForLogin cache can continue returning the old login IDP set. The original state must be fetched from the delegate or copied before mutation.

findings.title: getForLogin does not check organization invalidation
findings.body: The new getForLogin cache only checks isInvalid(cacheKey). The analogous getByOrganization method checks both isInvalid(cacheKey) and isInvalid(orgId) because organization changes can affect the cached IDP result. For getForLogin(ORG_ONLY/ALL, organizationId), a cached per-organization IDP list can survive organization invalidation/removal. If the organization change unlinks or removes an IDP without going through IdentityProviderStorageProvider.update/remove, login pages for that organization keep using stale IDP IDs. The method should also fall back when organizationId is non-null and isInvalid(organizationId) is true.

findings.title: remove can throw NPE for missing alias when cache key is invalid
findings.body: remove(alias) now always loads storedIdp and then, when the alias cache key is invalid, calls registerIDPInvalidation(storedIdp). If the alias does not exist, storedIdp is null and registerIDPInvalidation dereferences it, throwing NPE. The method contract says remove should return false when no IDP is found, so this path must null-check storedIdp before invalidating.

findings.title: Test cleanup removes alias "alias" instead of the created IDPs
findings.body: The cleanup registered at lines 381 and 425 uses testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove, but the test creates IDPs named "idp-alias-0" through "idp-alias-20". The cleanup therefore never removes the created providers and may also fail with a not-found error, leaking IDPs into the test realm and making subsequent tests order-dependent.
